title: Israeli Artillery Shells Southern Quneitra Near Tal al-Ahmar al-Sharqi
detail: Israeli forces fired artillery shells into the southern Quneitra countryside near Tal al-Ahmar al-Sharqi on July 30, 2026, part of what monitors tallied as roughly 53 distinct Israeli attacks on southwest Syria since the start of 2026 (four airstrikes, 49 ground-force actions) — a pace matching all of 2025's ~450 incursions in barely half the time. No casualties were reported from this specific incident. UNDOF has increased its deployments along the area following the pattern of near-daily incursions into Quneitra and Daraa.

media.caption: Israeli occupation forces shell the vicinity of Tal al-Ahmar al-Sharqi in the Quneitra countryside
